items.s: Aiyuk, per agent Drew Rosenhaus, is scheduled to visit the Commanders on Wednesday, Adam Schefter of ESPN reports. Aiyuk cleared waivers earlier Tuesday, and he will discuss a potential partnership with Washington a day later. There are still plenty of things to shake out on both sides, but Aiyuk did play with Commanders quarterback Jayden Daniels in college at Arizona State, so there is at least one connection already in place.

Aiyuk cleared waivers Tuesday and became a free agent, Adam Schefter of ESPN reports. After Aiyuk was cut by the 49ers on Monday when his two-week roster exemption expired, none of the league's other 31 teams were willing to cover the prorated salary of $472,500 he was due for the remainder of the season and the hefty non-guaranteed salaries he held for 2027 and 2028. Now that he's able to test the open market, Aiyuk is expected to draw interest from multiple teams. According to Ian Rapoport of NFL Network, Washington is viewed as a potential landing spot for Aiyuk, with the Commanders likely looking to add the 28-year-old wideout to their practice squad.

items.h: Brandon Aiyuk Trending Towards Joining Commanders' Practice Squad
items.s: Former San Francisco 49ers wide receiver Brandon Aiyuk will meet with the Washington Commanders on Wednesday, and he has also talked to Washington quarterback Jayden Daniels and another Commanders player in recent days, making it more likely that Aiyuk will land on the Commanders' practice squad, sources told CBS Sports' Matt Zenitz. The 28-year-old former first-rounder was waived by the 49ers on Monday and cleared waivers on Tuesday, making him available to sign with any NFL team for the remainder of the 2026 season. It is unclear if other teams are interested in adding Aiyuk, but the Commanders continue to be the favorite to land him, mainly because of his previous history with Daniels…

items.h: Brandon Aiyuk released by San Fransisco 49ers
items.s: Brandon Aiyuk has been released by the San Fransisco 49ers after a long standoff and holdout situation. Aiyuk is now expected to sign with the Commanders practice squad and re-unite with college QB Jayden Daniels. However, multiple WR needy teams could take the opportunity to take a glance at him, so don't be surprised if rumors abound. We'll get a much better idea of his potential fantasy value once he joins an NFL squad. He hasn't played since 2024, so a slow start would be expected, and his redraft value will likely be minimal, but taking a shot at the upside he might possess is worth it for those with bench space.

The 49ers waived Aiyuk on Monday, Adam Schefter of ESPN reports. San Francisco officially has parted ways with Aiyuk, whose two-week roster exemption expired Monday after he filed his paperwork for reinstatement. Given that Aiyuk has approximately $58 million in non-guaranteed money remaining on his contract and hasn't even practiced in a professional setting since sustaining a multi-ligament right knee tear in October 2024, he'll almost certainly go unclaimed off waivers and become a free agent. items.h: Commanders the "Most Likely Landing Spot" for Brandon Aiyuk
items.s: The Washington Commanders could offer pending free-agent wide receiver Brandon Aiyuk a spot on their practice squad, according to Ian Rapoport of the NFL Network. With their roster exemption expired, the San Francisco 49ers are releasing the former first-rounder on Monday, and he is expected to clear waivers. Rapoport believes that the Commanders are the most likely landing spot for Aiyuk, especially now that he has reportedly cleared any differences with quarterback Jayden Daniels, his college teammate at Arizona State. items.h: Brandon Aiyuk's Roster Exemption Expires Monday, "All Signs Point" Toward his Release
items.s: Former Pro Bowl wide receiver Brandon Aiyuk's roster exemption is set to expire, and all signs point to the San Francisco 49ers releasing him. Aiyuk was placed on the reserve/left quad list last season after he stopped reporting to the facility in 2025. Earlier this month, the NFL filed for reinstatement and met with the 49ers front office as he hopes to be granted his release. If Aiyuk is cut by the team, he will go through waivers before becoming a free agent since the trade deadline has officially passed.
